ability.travelersbackpack.iron: Heavy. Shrugs off a quarter of all knockback
ability.travelersbackpack.gold: Piglins treat you as if you were wearing gold
ability.travelersbackpack.diamond: Hardened plating that adds armor toughness
ability.travelersbackpack.emerald: Fortune favors you. Lucky Blocks roll noticeably better outcomes
ability.travelersbackpack.enderman: Sneak and jump to blink about 6 blocks in the direction you're looking. Recharges in 20 seconds
ability.travelersbackpack.melon: Glistering: when you drop to 4 hearts, it heals you for 4 hearts. Recharges every few minutes. Placed, it can drop melon slices when harvested
ability.travelersbackpack.cactus: Attackers prick themselves on the spines. In the rain, it fills empty tanks with water, even when placed
ability.travelersbackpack.ghast: Ghasts see you as an ally unless you attack them. Sneak in midair to float down gently
ability.travelersbackpack.warden: Slowness II on hit for 2 seconds. Immune to Darkness
ability.travelersbackpack.ocelot: Speed when hostile mobs are near. Creepers flee from you and phantoms leave you alone
ability.travelersbackpack.chicken: You lay eggs! Hold jump in midair to flutter down slowly
ability.travelersbackpack.iron_golem: Immune to knockback, and iron golems never turn on you
ability.travelersbackpack.end: Falling into the void pulls you back to the last solid ground you stood on. Recharges in 10 minutes
ability.travelersbackpack.horse: Whatever you're riding gets Speed and Jump Boost
ability.travelersbackpack.sheep: Soft landing. Fall damage is halved
ability.travelersbackpack.wolf: Pack leader. Your tamed animals within 16 blocks get Regeneration and Strength
ability.travelersbackpack.skeleton: Each arrow you fire has a 33% chance not to be used up
ability.travelersbackpack.snow: Immune to freezing, and you can walk on powder snow
ability.travelersbackpack.sandstone: Moves 20% faster on sand, including dream sand
ability.travelersbackpack.coal: Furnace, smoker and blast furnace upgrades in this backpack cook without fuel
